statement_en: In the Lebesgue measure space $(\mathbb{R},\mathcal{F},m)$, consider the decreasing sequence $E_n:=[n,+\infty)$. Their intersection is the empty set, since if $x\in \bigcap_{n\geq 1}E_n$, then $x$ would be greater than every positive integer, which is impossible. However, $\mu(E_n)=+\infty$ for all $n\geq 1$, so the conclusion of continuity from above fails without the finite-measure assumption.
callout_body: 当我们考虑Lebesgue测度空间$(\mathbb{R},\mathcal{F},m)$的时候，考虑一列单调下降的集合序列$E_n:=[n,+\infty)$,这一列集合的交集实际上是一个空集。因为$E:=\cap_{n\geq 1}E_n$，那么任意实数$x$如果$x \in E$,它会大于任意正整数，这是不可能的。因此$E$实际上是空集，然而$\mu(E_n)=+\infty,\forall n\geq 1$，所以这是不可能的。
